Change c0451. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. VI; 1831 Ch. XXIII.

Context before (unchanged): I had been calm during the day; but so soon as night obscured the shapes of objects, a thousand fears arose in my mind.

1818 text: I was anxious and watchful, while my right hand grasped a pistol which was hidden in my bosom; every sound terrified me; but I resolved that I would sell my life dearly, and not relax the impending conflict until my own life, or that of my adversary, were extinguished. Elizabeth observed my agitation for some time in timid and fearful silence; at length she said, "What is it that agitates you, my dear Victor?

1831 text: I was anxious and watchful, while my right hand grasped a pistol which was hidden in my bosom; every sound terrified me; but I resolved that I would sell my life dearly, and not shrink from the conflict until my own life, or that of my adversary, was extinguished. Elizabeth observed my agitation for some time in timid and fearful silence; but there was something in my glance which communicated terror to her, and trembling she asked, "What is it that agitates you, my dear Victor?

Diff: I was anxious and watchful, while my right hand grasped a pistol which was hidden in my bosom; every sound terrified me; but I resolved that I would sell my life dearly, and not [-relax-] {+shrink from+} the [-impending-] conflict until my own life, or that of my adversary, [-were-] {+was+} extinguished. Elizabeth observed my agitation for some time in timid and fearful silence; [-at length-] {+but there was something in my glance which communicated terror to her, and trembling+} she [-said-] {+asked+} , " What is it that agitates you, my dear Victor?

Context after (unchanged): What is it you fear?"

result.rationale: The added clause 'there was something in my glance which communicated terror to her' makes Victor's own look frighten Elizabeth, shifting how he presents himself. Other edits ('shrink from', 'impending' cut, 'was', 'asked') are wording-level.
